en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large villa or hotel complex in a hilly, wooded landscape. A narrow road runs along the left foreground, fenced pasture and grassland lead up to several multi‑storey buildings with steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, balconies and verandas. Forested hills form the background under a partly cloudy sky. The handwritten caption along the bottom margin identifies the location.
